title.en: Seal Ring, Guard Ring and Scribe Line

body.zh: 芯片最外圈，核心电路与划片槽之间，整颗 die 一圈
body.en: At the outermost chip perimeter, between the core circuit and scribe line, Surrounding the entire die

body.zh: Diff + Contact+各层 Via+各层Metal，全层次叠加的闭合环
body.en: Diff + Contact + Vias at all levels + Metal at all levels, Stacked into a closed ring

body.zh: 挡切割裂纹、防水汽污染、泄放静电、屏蔽外部干扰
body.en: Stop dicing cracks, block moisture and contamination, discharge Static electricity and shield external interference

body.zh: 电路内部，围在模块/器件周围（如模拟与数字模块之间）
body.en: Inside the circuit, around modules / devices (e.g. between analog and digital blocks)

body.zh: 通常只是衬底接触（P+）或Nwell 环，层次很少
body.en: Usually substrate contacts (P+) or An Nwell ring, with few layers

body.zh: 收集少数载流子、抑制闩锁、隔离模块间噪声
body.en: Collect minority carriers, suppress latch-up and isolate Noise between modules

body.zh: 相邻芯片之间的留白通道，不是任何芯片的一部分
body.en: A blank channel between adjacent chips, not Part of either chip

body.zh: 不做电路的切割留白区，常放工艺监控测试结构
body.en: A blank dicing region without circuitry, often containing Process-monitoring test structures

body.zh: 记忆法：Guard Ring 护的是电路内部的模块，Seal Ring 护的是整颗芯片的边缘；
body.en: Memory aid: Guard Ring protects internal circuit blocks; Seal Ring protects the edge of the entire chip;

body.zh: 而 Scribe Line 根本不长在芯片上——它是芯片与芯片之间、留给刀走的路。
body.en: Scribe Line is not on the chip at all—it is the path between chips reserved for cutting.

body.zh: 芯片科普 · Seal Ring · 收藏这篇，下次看版图不迷路
body.en: Chip knowledge · Seal Ring · Save this guide to navigate layouts next time

body.zh: 划片刀 / 激光从这里走刀，把晶
body.en: A dicing saw / laser cuts here, dividing
